name: markdown_tables_held_out
description: Held-out markdown-table events to test generalization beyond the v5 training set. Content intentionally uses tech stacks and topics NOT present in the 68 organic training samples (aviation, game dev, bio-lab, retail, satellite, firmware). Ground truth: 6 DECISION (tables that document a commitment / choice / specification) + 6 NOISE (tables that are routine status snapshots). Tests whether v5 learned 'table-shaped content can be DECISION' generically, or just memorized the specific markdown tables in training.

# ADR-014: Flight Planner Event Bus (2026-05-12)

## Context
The flight planner service must emit ~8K events/sec during peak hours. We compared two event-bus options.

## Options

| Option  | Throughput | Ops burden | Cost/mo | Team skill |
|---------|-----------|-----------|---------|-----------|
| Kafka   | 2M/sec    | High      | $3,200  | Yes       |
| NATS JS | 600K/sec  | Low       | $800    | No        |

## Decision
Adopt NATS JetStream. Throughput headroom is 75x over peak; ops burden is the real bottleneck given our 2-engineer SRE team.

## Engine Selection for Project Hyacinth (2026-05-04)

After a 3-week spike we ran the following scoring matrix on the two candidate engines.

| Criterion        | Weight | Godot 4.4 | Bevy 0.15 |
|------------------|--------|-----------|-----------|
| Team onboarding  | 25%    | 9         | 4         |
| Rendering perf   | 20%    | 7         | 9         |
| Tooling maturity | 20%    | 9         | 5         |
| Console export   | 15%    | 8         | 3         |
| Mod ecosystem    | 10%    | 7         | 6         |
| License          | 10%    | MIT-ish   | MIT       |

Weighted totals: Godot 7.95, Bevy 5.55.

**Chosen: Godot 4.4.** Console export was the hard blocker for Bevy; mod ecosystem tied.

# Cytometry Panel A -- Final Cutoff Table (v1.2)

After running 1,200 calibration samples, these are the approved gates for Panel A reports. Supersedes v1.0 and v1.1.

| Channel | Gate low | Gate high | Positivity |
|---------|----------|-----------|-----------|
| CD45    | 180      | 3,500     | >= 240    |
| CD14    | 60       | 1,800     | >= 110    |
| HLA-DR  | 90       | 2,100     | >= 150    |
| CD16    | 40       | 1,200     | >= 75     |

Signed off by the lab director. Applies to all runs starting Batch 2026-05-A.

# Store Rollout Plan for Inventory-V2 (2026-05-20)

Previously proposed a big-bang cutover; exec team pushed back. New plan is a 3-wave rollout with go/no-go gates.

| Wave | Stores | Region   | Cutover date | Gate criterion         |
|------|--------|----------|--------------|------------------------|
| 1    | 12     | LATAM-S  | 2026-06-02   | <= 2 P1 incidents/wk   |
| 2    | 48     | LATAM-N  | 2026-06-23   | Wave 1 green for 3 wks |
| 3    | 140    | EU       | 2026-07-14   | Wave 2 green for 3 wks |

Declared approach: pause and escalate at any gate miss, do not skip waves.
